S1.title: Section 1: Damage to your car
S1.text: We cover loss of or damage to your car caused by accident, up to its market value, less the excess. Comprehensive cover only.

S2.title: Section 2: Liability to others
S2.text: We cover your legal liability for injury to others and damage to their property. All cover levels.

S3.title: Section 3: Fire and theft
S3.text: We cover loss or damage caused by fire, theft or attempted theft. Comprehensive and third party, fire and theft.

S6.title: Section 6: No-claims discount
S6.text: Your discount is not affected by a claim where we recover all our costs from someone else, or where protected no-claims discount is on your schedule.

E1.title: General exclusion 1: Driver not insured
E1.text: No cover while your car is driven by anyone not named on your certificate and schedule.

E2.title: General exclusion 2: Use not permitted
E2.text: No cover while your car is used for hire, reward or delivery unless your certificate permits it.

E4.title: General exclusion 4: Racing
E4.text: No cover while your car is used for racing, pace-making or speed testing.

E6.title: General exclusion 6: Territory
E6.text: No cover outside Great Britain, Northern Ireland, the Isle of Man and the Channel Islands.

B1.title: Add-on: Courtesy car
B1.text: A small courtesy car while your car is repaired by our approved repairer, if the add-on is on your schedule.

B2.title: Add-on: Motor legal expenses
B2.text: Up to £100,000 of legal costs to recover uninsured losses from the person at fault, if the add-on is on your schedule.

HC172.title: Highway Code rule 172
HC172.text: You must give way to traffic on the main road when emerging from a junction with broken white lines across the road.

HC175.title: Highway Code rule 175
HC175.text: You must stop behind the white stop line across your side of the road unless the light is green.

HC185.title: Highway Code rule 185
HC185.text: On reaching a roundabout, give priority to traffic approaching from your right, unless signs, markings or lights say otherwise.

HC126.title: Highway Code rule 126
HC126.text: Drive at a speed that lets you stop well within the distance you can see to be clear, and leave enough space to the vehicle in front.

HC133.title: Highway Code rule 133
HC133.text: Before changing lane, check mirrors and make sure you will not force another road user to change course or speed.

HC103.title: Highway Code rule 103
HC103.text: Signals warn and inform other road users. Give clear signals in plenty of time.

HC130.title: Highway Code rule 130
HC130.text: Areas of white diagonal stripes or chevrons separate traffic lanes. You should not enter them unless it is necessary and you can see that it is safe.

HC211.title: Highway Code rule 211
HC211.text: Look out for motorcyclists, particularly when emerging from a junction. They can be hard to see and their speed is easy to misjudge.

HC227.title: Highway Code rule 227
HC227.text: In wet weather stopping distances are at least double those on dry roads. Keep well back and slow down, especially on bends.
